critical.issue: Returns 502 'Stripe error: No such checkout.session' for every legitimately-created session. ROOT CAUSE: hire_dev_team_checkout creates the session via emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout which routes to Emergent's Stripe proxy (https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions, confirmed in backend logs). The status endpoint then uses raw stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(session_id) which hits api.stripe.com — but the session ID was minted on the proxy and is not visible to the public Stripe API → 404 → wrapped as HTTPException(502). Repro: 1) POST /api/chats/{id}/hire-dev-team/checkout (200, gets cs_test_a1... session_id). 2) Immediately GET /api/chats/{id}/hire-dev-team/status/{session_id} → 502 with body 'Stripe error: No such checkout.session: cs_test_a1...'. Impact: the entire post-payment polling path (Chats.jsx ?dev_team_session_id= → status poll → applied=true → provision team) is broken end-to-end. The user pays $599, gets redirected back, and the team never auto-provisions because every status call 502s. The webhook path (routes/billing.py _handle_checkout_session_completed) may still recover this IF Emergent's Stripe proxy actually delivers webhooks to /api/webhook/stripe, but the polling fallback is dead. FIX: either (a) use the same StripeCheckout/emergentintegrations client to look up the session (it probably has a get_session method), or (b) configure stripe.api_base = 'https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe' before the retrieve, mirroring whatever the integration library does internally.

rca of the issue: Root cause for the /status 502 bug: two Stripe code paths in the same request lifecycle use DIFFERENT Stripe API bases. Checkout creation goes through `emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout(api_key=…, webhook_url=…).create_checkout_session(...)` which under the hood points at https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe (Emergent's managed Stripe proxy) — confirmed in backend logs: 'INFO:stripe:message=Request to Stripe api method=post url=https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions response_code=200'. The status endpoint then does `stripe.api_key = sk_test_emergent; stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(session_id)` which uses the default `stripe.api_base = https://api.stripe.com`. That public Stripe API has no record of the session minted on the proxy, so it returns 404 (error_code=resource_missing), which is caught and re-raised as HTTPException(502, 'Stripe error: No such checkout.session: …'). Fix is one-liner: set `stripe.api_base = 'https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe'` immediately before the retrieve, OR use whatever retrieve helper the emergentintegrations package provides. Without this, the redirect→poll→provision flow can only succeed via the webhook path (routes/billing.py _handle_checkout_session_completed), which is asynchronous and unreliable for in-session UX.
